fato_historico: 1978: Cardinal Karol Wojtyła is elected to the papacy as Pope John Paul II, he becomes the first non-Italian pontiff since 1523.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to step into a new role of leadership and quiet authority. Much like a historic shift in tradition, you may find it is a good time to redefine your path. Consider how your unique perspective can guide others toward hope and profound growth during this transformative and empowering cycle.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light has the power to transcend all traditional boundaries.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual wisdom and inner soul searching.
conselho: Trust your intuition and be open to unexpected changes in your journey.
